parameters.content:
## Shopify App Review Intelligence

### How it works

A weekly or manual run loads configuration saved by the setup form, runs the FetchCat Shopify App Reviews Scraper, validates recent review records, checks a durable Data Table ledger, and sends at most one evidence-linked Slack digest after one structured OpenAI analysis. The model may summarize only supplied reviews, and every cited review ID is checked before delivery. Reviews are committed to the ledger only after Slack succeeds.

### Setup

Connect Apify, OpenAI, and Slack credentials. Select the Slack channel in `Send Slack Review Digest`. Run `Shopify Review Setup Form` once with one to three app URLs or handles, product context, ratings, lookback days, and the per-app limit. Test manually before activating the schedule.

## Monitor and deduplicate

Normal runs exit before Apify until setup exists. Recent valid reviews are capped at 30 and checked against `FetchCat Delivery Ledger` before AI.

## Analyze one batch

One strict OpenAI request identifies product signals. Validation rejects unknown review IDs, malformed groups, and unsupported actionable claims.

## Deliver then commit

Slack receives one concise evidence-linked digest only when actionable insights exist. Review keys are committed only after delivery succeeds.

## Configure without editing code

The setup form validates targets, context, ratings, lookback, and limits, then saves one reusable configuration row. Repeating setup updates that row.
